extraction_scope: Worker-6 source-reviewed final mechanism ontology from primary XML/PDF evidence; automated pending-review locator notes were replaced with adjudicated, assay-bounded mechanism claims.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: RMP16 is adjudicated as a TNFRI-selective TNF-derived peptide because primary SPR/ITC and radioligand competition data show much stronger TNFRI than TNFRII engagement.

source_locator.locator: xml:sec=5:RMP16 inhibited proliferation of multiple tumor cells; xml:fig=2:Figure 2E

mechanism_claims.limitations: TNFRI selectivity is directly supported; downstream cellular effects are in DU145/HUVEC models, not antimicrobial MIC assays.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: RMP16 induces DU145 apoptosis through caspase-dependent markers in the primary DU145 assays.

source_locator.locator: xml:sec=6:RMP16 significantly induced apoptosis for Du145 cell

mechanism_claims.limitations: Mechanism is cancer-cell apoptosis; it must not be generalized to antibacterial membrane disruption.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: RMP16 blocks DU145 cell-cycle progression with increased G0/G1 fraction and reduced S/G2-M fractions, with P21/P27 and cyclin/E2F1 changes reported.

source_locator.locator: xml:sec=6:RMP16 significantly induced apoptosis for Du145 cell

mechanism_claims.limitations: Gene-chip details are discussed qualitatively; final record keeps the source-reported cell-cycle measurements rather than inferring a broader pathway.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: RMP16 inhibits tumor angiogenesis and CAM neovascularization in primary in-vivo/ex-vivo assays.
mechanism_claims.entity_scope: RMP16 in DU145 xenograft and chick CAM models

source_locator.locator: xml:sec=9:RMP16 inhibited tumor angiogenesis and neovascularization

mechanism_claims.limitations: Antiangiogenesis is supported in tumor/CAM models; it is not an antimicrobial mechanism claim.

caution_findings.evidence_context: The primary paper is an antitumor/TNF-receptor study. No antimicrobial MIC or membrane-disruption assay is present locally.
